observations.title: 第一次观察：木块在盘外
observations.explanation: 从臂处于折叠位，先检查木块、蓝色盘子和两路画面。第一条动作只向上试探 2 cm。

next_command.note: Initial 2 cm upward probe from folded pose; verify measured motion and both camera views before proceeding

observations.title: 向上试探后重新观察
observations.explanation: 读回位置和画面变化支持向上的运动方向；接下来分段展开。

next_command.note: Initial upward probe matched expected direction; unfold slowly to the first high-clearance observation waypoint

observations.title: 展开到第一中间位
observations.explanation: 在远离桌面的高度展开，每段动作后重新取图。

next_command.note: High-clearance unfolding continues toward the calibrated observation pose; scene is clear in wrist and fixed cameras

observations.title: 继续展开，看到工作区
observations.explanation: 木块和盘子已进入腕部视野，继续到便于俯视的观察位。

next_command.note: Continue to observation pose above the work area; cube and plate are visible ahead and the hand remains well above the tabletop

observations.title: 到达高处观察位
observations.explanation: 先张开夹爪，让目标与两指都能被看清。

next_command.note: At the high observation pose, open the gripper fully to view and approach the cube with clear jaw separation

observations.title: 夹爪全开，定位木块
observations.explanation: 从腕部图像和深度估计木块位置，先在高处横向对准。

next_command.note: Depth confirms cube on tabletop at the right of wrist view; move at high clearance above its estimated location, keep jaws open, and reobserve before descending

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 移动到木块上方
observations.explanation: 木块已经位于两指之间，深度仍显示较大的桌面间隙。

next_command.note: Cube lies 11 mm to the right of the calibrated grasp line at depth 0.248 m; correct laterally and descend only 2 cm, then reobserve

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 修正偏差，下降 2 cm
observations.explanation: 用画面中的残余偏差修正位置，保持小步下降。

next_command.note: Cube is centered between open jaws at high clearance; descend another 2 cm while holding orientation and lateral target

observations.title: 木块保持在两指之间
observations.explanation: 下降后再次确认木块仍在抓取线附近。

next_command.note: Cube remains centered and visible; continue the guarded descent by 2 cm with both jaws open

observations.title: 继续小步下降
observations.explanation: 保留当前姿态，继续下降并检查画面。

next_command.note: No contact or obstruction visible; descend 2 cm more, remaining approximately 8 cm above the table

observations.title: 下降至约 9 cm 间隙
observations.explanation: 深度核验用于区分木块顶面与桌面，避免把顶面当成下降终点。

next_command.note: Fresh depth places the cube top at 0.176 m and table at 0.204 m; correct the remaining 5 mm image offset and descend 2 cm

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 修正约 5 mm 的偏差
observations.explanation: 按新的画面修正横向偏差，然后再次下降。

next_command.note: Cube remains centered on the grasp line and gripper is clear of the table; descend 2 cm to the next observation level

observations.title: 接近木块上方
observations.explanation: 接近木块时缩小移动步幅，下一条先保持位置获取稳定读数。

next_command.note: fresh observation

observations.title: 保持姿态，核验深度
observations.explanation: 这次 hold 只更新观测；额外深度检查显示桌面和木块顶面的距离。

next_command.note: Depth plane gives 45 mm fingertip clearance and 29 mm cube height; correct about 3 mm laterally and lower only 15 mm with the jaws fully open

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 手指下降到木块两侧
observations.explanation: 手指逐渐进入木块两侧，木块尚未移动。

next_command.note: Cube stays stationary and centered; lower 12 mm so the open fingers extend beside the cube, retaining a checked table margin

observations.title: 接近闭爪高度
observations.explanation: 在闭爪前保持目标不变，等待实测姿态稳定。

next_command.note: fresh observation

observations.title: 等待稳定，再测桌面间隙
observations.explanation: 基于新深度仅再下降 3.5 mm，同时保留桌面安全余量。

next_command.note: Fresh depth shows 18 mm physical fingertip clearance; lower only 3.5 mm, preserving the conservative nominal clearance gate before closing around the cube sides

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 最后下降 3.5 mm
observations.explanation: 先缓慢收拢到中间开度，观察两指与木块的相对位置。

next_command.note: Cube top is centered between the open pads; close gradually to an intermediate opening and inspect contact before the final grip

observations.title: 先收拢到中间开度
observations.explanation: 两指位于木块两侧，随后继续闭合到抓取目标。

next_command.note: Both pads bracket the cube without pushing it; close to the previously used grasp target, then validate retention with a short lift

observations.title: 两指夹住木块
observations.explanation: 闭爪画面只是抓取候选，下一步先小幅抬起验证。

next_command.note: Jaws are closed around the cube; lift only 2 cm to test whether the cube stays in the fingers. Do not transport until camera evidence confirms retention.

observations.title: 第一次短距离抬升
observations.explanation: 木块仍保持在两指之间，但还需要停稳和继续抬升来确认。

next_command.note: fresh observation

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 停住，确认木块仍在指间
observations.explanation: 重新观察后，木块相对夹爪的位置未明显改变。

next_command.note: Cube remains fixed between the pads after the first lift, with depth about 0.106 m; raise another 2 cm vertically to confirm sustained clearance before any lateral transport

observations.title: 第二次短距离抬升
observations.explanation: 木块继续随夹爪抬升，尚不急于横向搬运。

next_command.note: The cube stays in the same location against both pads after a second lift; gain another 2.5 cm of clearance before crossing toward the plate

observations.title: 继续抬高，木块离桌
observations.explanation: 固定相机可见木块离开桌面，继续留出越过盘沿的高度。

next_command.note: Fixed view confirms the cube has left the table and remains suspended in the jaws; raise another 2.5 cm to clear the plate rim during transport

observations.title: 获得搬运所需间隙
observations.explanation: 连续抬升后木块仍在指间，开始分段搬运。

next_command.note: Cube is securely retained after successive vertical lifts; move slowly through a high intermediate waypoint toward the blue plate while maintaining the grip

observations.title: 移动到中间位置
observations.explanation: 第一段横移后木块仍被夹住，继续移向盘子中心。

next_command.note: Cube remains held during the first transport segment; move to the estimated plate center at high clearance and verify alignment before lowering

observations.title: 到达蓝色盘子上方
observations.explanation: 两路画面支持木块位于盘子内部上方，开始降低高度。

next_command.note: Wrist view places the held cube over the plate interior with margin to all edges; begin a 2 cm controlled descent while retaining the grip

observations.title: 在盘内上方下降
observations.explanation: 保持夹持，分段降低，并检查夹爪与盘沿的相对位置。

next_command.note: Cube remains held and centered over the plate; descend 2 cm more, keeping the fingers away from the rim

observations.title: 继续下降，保持夹持
observations.explanation: 盘子仍在木块下方，继续小步下降。

next_command.note: The plate remains beneath the cube and clear of both fingers; lower another 2 cm before measuring the final release height

observations.title: 接近放置高度
observations.explanation: 下降后先保持，再用深度核对盘底距离。

next_command.note: fresh observation

observations.title: 停住，核验盘底深度
observations.explanation: 深度读数：木块顶面约 0.106 m、盘底约 0.164 m；用于选择最后的下降量。

next_command.note: Depth measures cube top at 0.106 m and plate floor at 0.164 m; lower 15 mm, leaving about 1–2 cm beneath the cube before release

depth.note: 姿态保持期间额外采集；不是每次策略观测都包含深度。

observations.title: 最后下降 15 mm
observations.explanation: 木块低位悬在盘子内部上方，下一条缓慢张爪。

next_command.note: Cube is low over the plate interior and the jaws clear the rim; open slowly to release it, then inspect the plate before withdrawing

observations.title: 已松爪：木块留在盘内
observations.explanation: 两路图像显示木块已留在盘中；先竖直抬起空夹爪验证它不会被带走。

next_command.note: Both camera views show the released cube resting inside the blue plate and the jaws open; withdraw vertically 2 cm and verify it stays in place

observations.title: 竖直撤离，复核放置
observations.explanation: 撤离后木块仍静止在盘内，继续抬高空夹爪。

next_command.note: Cube stayed at rest in the plate after withdrawal; raise the empty open gripper another 2.5 cm to prepare a clear return path

observations.title: 继续抬起空夹爪
observations.explanation: 空夹爪逐步离开木块和盘沿。

next_command.note: Empty gripper clears the cube and the cube is still stable in the plate; gain 2.5 cm more clearance before retracting toward the base

observations.title: 获得回程间隙
observations.explanation: 已有足够间隙，开始向基座方向撤回。

next_command.note: Cube is stationary in the plate and the empty fingers are clear; retract upward to the known observation pose through a fully checked joint path

observations.title: 退回高处观察位
observations.explanation: 回到观察位后再次看到木块留在盘内，然后按已检查路径收臂。

next_command.note: Cube remains in the plate after retreat; reverse the tested high-clearance unfolding path, first intermediate folding waypoint

observations.title: 沿已检查路径收臂
observations.explanation: 回程仍分段执行，每段检查新的画面与读回。

next_command.note: Continue folding along the already observed clear path; cube remains in the plate and the empty hand is away from it

observations.title: 继续收臂
observations.explanation: 空夹爪远离目标，完成最后一段收臂。

next_command.note: Final slow return to the folded joint pose; hand is empty and table objects remain untouched

observations.title: 回到折叠位
observations.explanation: 六关节已回折叠位，随后闭合空夹爪。

next_command.note: Arm is back at the folded joint pose, empty gripper clear of objects; close the empty gripper for parking

observations.title: 空夹爪闭合，准备结束
observations.explanation: 末次策略观测：木块仍在盘内，随后发送 done 并正常释放 SDK。

next_command.note: Visually verified success: cube rests fully inside the blue plate after release and gripper withdrawal; arm returned to folded pose and empty gripper closed.
next_command.hindsight: Use native wrist 640x480, wait for SDK feedback at connect, and override fingertip length to 0.19 m. Align from measured pose and depth, respect static joint offset, close gradually, verify retained cube by successive short vertical lifts, and check release in both views. Only issue explicit checked return motions; do not auto-park from an arbitrary low pose.

provenance.judgement: Codex 检查双路图像，确认放置和撤离后的实际结果
